title: The development of carbon-neutral data centres in space
authors: Ablimit Aili; Jihwan Choi; Yew Soon Ong; Yonggang Wen
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Zhejiang University, Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology, Agency for Science, Technology and Research

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centres suffer from high energy consumption and large carbon footprints, while space-based data generation faces high latency and energy costs when processed on Earth.
problem_statement.zh: 地面資料中心面臨高能耗與龐大碳足跡的挑戰，而太空產生的資料若在地球上處理，則需承受高 latency 與高能源成本。

key_innovation.en: A framework for carbon-neutral orbital data centres (edge and cloud) that leverages abundant solar energy in space and deep space as a natural cold heat sink for radiative cooling.
key_innovation.zh: 針對碳中性軌道資料中心（邊緣與雲端）所提出的框架：利用太空中豐沛的太陽能，並以深太空作為天然冷熱沉以實現輻射散熱。

baselines_compared: Google data centres, terrestrial data centres powered by mixed and all-renewable electric grids

key_improvements.en: Orbital cloud data centres achieve a lifecycle CUE comparable to or better than terrestrial data centres powered by all-renewable energy grids, with zero scope 2 emissions.
key_improvements.zh: 軌道雲端資料中心的全生命週期 CUE 可達到或優於全再生能源電網供電的地面資料中心，且範疇二排放為零。

ai_task: AI Inference, AI Model Training, Large-scale scientific simulations, Space-native big data processing
compute_memory_hw: Dell R740 servers, NPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs
